Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Geo Print Cotton Decorative Throw Pillow, Soft and Stylish, 17" x 17", Blush
Colors: Blush
Bring mid-century flair into your home with retro prints and colors. Patterns of blush, green, gold and ivory add a cheerful, interesting update to couch, chair or bed. For a quick change-up, reverse it to the solid blush linen-look back. 17" x 17" Front: Cotton; Back: Polyster Polyester fiber-filled insert included Insert can be easily removed via a bottom zipper on the cover Wipe with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
